description: We are Climate Nanos Enterprise is tackling the Field Shift challenge using NASA Earth science and satellite data to help farmers adapt to changing weather and optimize yields. We bring expertise in software, AI/ML, data analysis, design, and hardware. We're actively looking for team members with skills in data visualization, storytelling, and statistics to help round out our project.
summary: Climate Nanos Enterprise is an advanced off-grid agricultural microgrid and decision-support web platform designed to help farmers adapt to shifting temperatures, extreme weather, and declining soil health. Addressing the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge, our solution integrates real-time microclimate telemetry, automated solenoid drip irrigation management, solid-state Peltier thermoelectric cold storage monitoring, and a digital crop marketplace. By harnessing NASA Earth observations and local soil parameters, the platform empowers growers to optimize crop rotation strategies, conserve water resources, and build long-term climate resilience.
details:
• What it Does & How it Works: The platform serves as an intelligent agricultural dashboard that correlates NASA Earth observation data (temperature patterns, precipitation, and soil moisture metrics) with farm-level telemetry. It analyzes these inputs to recommend optimal crop rotation schedules and precision water management routines.
  • Key Benefits & Impact: Mitigates climate shocks for farmers, minimizes water waste through data-driven drip irrigation rules, safeguards post-harvest produce via smart cold-storage monitoring, and shortens supply chains using an integrated digital crop marketplace.
  • Tools & Technologies Used: Developed using React.js, modern JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Netlify for cloud hosting, and GitHub for version control. Integrated with AI coding assistants for frontend architecture and workflow optimization.
  • Creativity & Considerations: Merges clean-technology hardware principles (off-grid solar microgrids, Peltier thermoelectric cooling, and automated valve manifolds) into a responsive, intuitive web interface designed for practical, real-world deployment.
